resolution: Reworked backdrops so the reference image is a freely-placed 3D object dragged with the transform gizmo, per the user's ask ('if u just give me the gizmo tool to move it around that would solve it'). Each backdrop row has a 'move' button that arms a 3-axis TransformGizmo on the quad in the viewport; dragging an arrow slides it (snapped, with a readout), empty-drag/scroll still orbits, Esc/done exits. The quad is centered at origin and placed via the mesh position (bd.pos), so dragging never re-bakes geometry. Replaced the confusing plane+offset sliders with this. Built clean; merge logic suite green.
